title: Week in pictures: the Artemis II lunar mission, a key Hungarian election and Trump's coveted arch
summary: Artemis II's astronauts closed out humanity's first lunar voyage in more than half a century, the run-up to Hungary's crucial election and artist drawings of US President Donald Trump's planned "triumphal" arch, which resembles Paris's Arc de Triomphe. Here's a look back at some of the week's most striking images.
